scripts.setup: npm --prefix harness install --omit=optional && npm --prefix viewer install
scripts.setup:ci: npm --prefix harness ci --include=optional && npm --prefix viewer ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix harness test && npm --prefix viewer test
scripts.legacy: node harness/bin/tae.mjs run evals/together/legacy.suite.mjs --runtime evals/together/runtime/local-judge.json --experiment-version together-legacy --view
scripts.hybrid: node harness/bin/tae.mjs run evals/together/hybrid.suite.mjs --runtime evals/together/runtime/local-judge.json --experiment-version together-hybrid --view
